bootstrap_rule: Resolved from declared metadata before scores. If independent clusters do not span conditions, resample whole conditions then whole clusters within condition. Otherwise resample whole shared clusters with fixed condition strata; a missing-condition draw contributes +infinity to the upper difference bound, never gets discarded.
primary_metric: Mean absolute angle error in degrees, equal origins and seven horizons within axis, equal axes within physical trial, equal physical trials within condition, equal declared conditions. No angle/error/activity-based exclusions.
scope: Prospective confirmation framework only. Metadata, source review, file/model/code commitments and all eligibility rules must be locked and public commitment committed before numerical overlap/schema screening or scoring. No independent confirmation exists until suitable new physical records pass the full evidence audit. Hash nonmatch does not prove physical independence. Unknown actual arrival lag cannot silently become zero; explicit synchronous-acquisition offline forecasting is a distinct supported scope.
